svg.title: Source frames in the final take
svg.desc: Counts of SOURCE screencast frames (JPEG files listed in a take log). Not output video frames, not render time, not file or archive size. final take r2 of the cashier tutorial (the first take is a different recording and is deliberately not included). Original take: 23,896 source frames, comprising 11,986 picked at some 30 fps output time and 11,910 never picked. Derived take for 30 fps: 11,986 source frames. Both bars share a linear axis from zero to 25,000 source frames.

g.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
